rubric.evidence: Fresh Chromium proof loaded https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@huggingface/transformers@3.7.5, created pipeline('feature-extraction','sentence-transformers/all-distilroberta-v1',{device:'wasm',dtype:'fp32'}), downloaded canonical onnx/model.onnx, and completed a real batch inference. Output retained in /tmp/distilroberta-probe-cdp.log; the committed route-complete validator repeats inference on all five routes at desktop and mobile.

Fresh browser output was dim=768 with nonconstant sample [-0.035161,0.056017,-0.003998,-0.014987,0.02194,-0.036464]. Semantic sanity: puppy/garden versus young dog/outside cosine=0.637573, while puppy/garden versus tax forms cosine=-0.042241 (margin=0.679814).

Page and worker declare the canonical source id, feature-extraction runtime task, WASM backend, fp32 canonical ONNX export, 326,244,228-byte model size, 768 dimensions, 128-word-piece truncation, and Apache-2.0 license.

Every route uses shared createModelLoader with modelId sentence-transformers/all-distilroberta-v1; absent weights require an explicit Download, while a current cached copy auto-initialises. The acceptance validator begins from a fresh Chrome profile and then reuses the validated cache across routes.

Shared loader supplies checking/download/progress/ready/retry/clear states. Each route catches inference errors and writes them into a visible status/output region rather than relying on console output.

Native labelled textarea/input/range/select/button controls drive similarity, semantic search, vector inspection, clustering, nearest-label classification, analogy arithmetic, and retrieve-then-rerank. The route-complete validator clicks every advertised operation.
All matrices, vectors, PCA points, scores, clusters, labels, analogies, and rankings are derived after worker responses containing real ONNX output. No canned result is inserted as live inference.

Native controls have visible labels, dynamic states use polite role=status regions, tables use headers, and the PCA SVG has an accessible name. Final manual screen-reader testing remains outside this run.

Flexible wrapping controls, auto-fit grids, logical sizing, and locally scrollable wide matrices prevent material clipping. The committed validator checks scrollWidth against innerWidth after real inference on every route at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3.

The 326 MB model, tokenisation, mean pooling, normalization, and ONNX inference run in a dedicated module worker. Main-thread reductions are bounded to small user-edited batches; worker completion includes measured inference latency.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible responsive sentence embedding comparison controls model download progress no horizontal overflow worker inference
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native labelled controls, semantic landmarks, visible focus, restrained polite live regions, and text as well as color for status.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied through native form controls, visible labels, role=status aria-live=polite regions, readable text scores, and semantic headings/tables.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Canonical npx modern-web-guidance@latest output retained at /tmp/distilroberta-modern-web-guidance.txt.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive forms controls mobile viewport horizontal overflow touch target
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use fluid flex/grid layouts and intrinsic sizing; constrain overflow to the component that genuinely needs scrolling.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied via wrapping flex controls, auto-fit minmax grids, max-inline-size, and overflow-x:auto on matrix/table wrappers.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Canonical search result retained at /tmp/distilroberta-modern-web-guidance-responsive.txt; acceptance validator checks every route at both viewports.

guidanceConsulted.query: web worker inference responsiveness long tasks INP
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Move heavy computation off the main thread or yield so input and rendering are not blocked.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied by running all target and composed model inference in dedicated workers; only bounded result rendering remains on the main thread.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Canonical search result retained at /tmp/distilroberta-modern-web-guidance-performance.txt; worker.js and composed established workers contain every model call.

openQuestions: How does mobile memory pressure behave when fp32 all-distilroberta-v1 and the q8 reranker coexist on lower-memory physical devices?
summary: Browser-proven canonical all-distilroberta-v1 family with real 768-d sentence embeddings, shared explicit-download/cache loader, worker inference, inspectable geometry, and a five-route runnable ladder.
